CustomField.description: Forecasted close date for pipeline reporting. Team should keep this current.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Used for forecasting on the Executive Dashboard. Set to the date you expect the PAL/ROE to be signed. Keep current — it drives the Sales Pipeline Funnel, past-due alerts, and the Active Pipeline / CX/Launch top tiles. This is NOT the standard Close Date.
CustomField.label: Projected Close Date
